capabilities: publish the current file via a single command
choose among configured publishers before posting
authenticate with a Magiedit API key
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not an editor; it only sends the current file to Magiedit for publishing.
extras: API keys must be created in the Magiedit web application; the instance URL defaults to magiedit.magitools.app.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Publish only targets Obsidian Publish, so notes cannot be sent to other publishing platforms from inside the editor.

relations.evidence: Official plugin to interact with magiedit

summary: Magiedit connector that publishes the currently open note to selected Magiedit publishers in one command.
